section.paragraph: This is a simple demo XML file. It contains various types of content including text, images, and prompts.
XML allows you to structure different types of content such as text, images, and other multimedia. Here is an example of text content.
Below is an example of how to include image links in XML.
This XML file is designed to demonstrate how different types of content can be represented in XML format.

application.name: Reload
application.synopsis: Reloads an Asterisk module, blocking the channel until the reload has completed.

parameter.name: module
parameter.para: The full name(s) of the target module(s) or resource(s) to reload. If omitted, everything will be reloaded.
The full names MUST be specified (e.g. chan_iax2 to reload IAX2 or pbx_config to reload the dialplan.

description.para: Reloads the specified (or all) Asterisk modules and reports success or failure. Success is determined by each individual module, and if all reloads are successful, that is considered an aggregate success. If multiple modules are specified and any module fails, then FAILURE will be returned. It is still possible that other modules did successfully reload, however.
Sets RELOADSTATUS to one of the following values:

variable.name: RELOADSTATUS
variable.value: Some or all of the specified modules failed to reload.
